standard.summary: no-materialize 前向内部用哪种实现。auto 按当前基准启发式选路，legacy 与 matmul 是两条等价的重排。
standard.effect: 只在 lokr_no_materialize_forward 打开时才有效；未打开时这个值不参与任何计算。auto 的判据是最大特征维 ≥ 2048 且 factor ≥ 16 才走 matmul，否则 legacy。
standard.whenToUse: 先在 auto 下短测；发现某条支路不稳或明显更慢时手动钉死，方便对照。
standard.avoidWhen: no-materialize 没开时不要调它——不会产生任何效果，只会让人误以为改动了什么。

optionDescriptions.auto: 按基准启发式选：大特征维 + 宽 factor 走 matmul，其余走 legacy。
optionDescriptions.legacy: F.linear 两段实现，小维度下更稳。
optionDescriptions.matmul: reshape 后 torch.matmul 两段实现。

standard_en.summary: Which implementation the no-materialize forward uses internally. auto follows the current benchmark heuristic; legacy and matmul are two equivalent rearrangements.
standard_en.effect: Only meaningful while lokr_no_materialize_forward is on; otherwise the value takes no part in any computation. auto picks matmul only when the largest feature dimension is at least 2048 and factor at least 16, otherwise legacy.
standard_en.whenToUse: Short-test under auto first; pin one branch by hand when it proves unstable or clearly slower, so runs stay comparable.
standard_en.avoidWhen: Do not tune it with no-materialize off -- nothing happens, which makes it look like a change was made.

optionDescriptions.auto: Benchmark heuristic: large feature dims with a wide factor go to matmul, the rest stay on legacy.
optionDescriptions.legacy: Two-stage F.linear, steadier at small dimensions.

advanced.principle: 值在 config adapter 里被白名单校验（auto / legacy / matmul），非法值回落 legacy 并打一条 warning；auto 分支的判据写在 LyCORIS 的 get_resolved_no_materialize_strategy 里，用的是 in_features / out_features 的较大值与 factor。
advanced.intervention: 只改 no-materialize 分支内部选哪条实现，不改变是否走该分支。
advanced.expectedImpact: 数值等价，差异在速度与瞬时显存；auto 的阈值来自既定基准，换模型不一定最优。
advanced.tradeoffs: 解析后的实际策略只在运行时确定，config 里看到的仍是 auto；要确认走了哪条得看模块的 get_resolved_no_materialize_strategy 结果或实测耗时。

advanced_en.principle: The value is whitelisted (auto / legacy / matmul) in the config adapter; anything else falls back to legacy with a warning. The auto rule lives in LyCORIS' get_resolved_no_materialize_strategy and uses the larger of in_features / out_features together with factor.
advanced_en.intervention: Chooses the implementation inside the no-materialize branch; it does not change whether that branch is taken.
advanced_en.expectedImpact: Numerically equivalent; the difference is speed and transient VRAM. auto's thresholds come from one benchmark and need not be optimal for another model.
advanced_en.tradeoffs: The resolved strategy is only known at runtime and the config still reads auto, so confirming the path means reading get_resolved_no_materialize_strategy or timing it.
